column2: Yeah... Even just those words mean a lot.{wait}{clear}Once these wounds heal, I'll go fight again.
Warlock
What is a Warlock?

A Warlock is a mage like me who's trained in combat.{wait}{clear}Ordinary mages just make special medicines or give prophecies. Only a handful have the skills to fight.{wait}{clear}Everyday life has no need for swordplay or magic that hurts people.
Why did you become a Warlock?

Why I became a Warlock...{wait}{clear}Well... Maybe it's better to say it just happened that way.{wait}{clear}After my master died, I set out on a journey to find someone, and along the way, many Guild lodges looked after me.{wait}{clear}And at some point, I'd naturally become a Warlock working for the Guild.
What do you do as a Warlock, Fein?
Work like trading information between Guild lodges and gathering intelligence on other countries.{wait}{clear}You're really grilling me... There's nothing more to say about Warlocks.
Journey
Why do you travel?
...I had to set out on a journey, no matter what... That's all...
Will you keep traveling?
Yeah... I still haven't achieved what I set out to do.
For you, Fein, traveling is...
Can we drop this subject?
More...?
Don't worry... If this tired me out, I'd be useless.
Yeah... I don't particularly mind...
Yeah...{wait}{clear}Maybe so...
That's nothing.{wait}{clear}If I picked level roads, I'd never reach where I'm going...
Do I look that unreliable?
How like an angel... Or rather, it's something only an angel would understand...
...You might think it's not like me, but I do think that sometimes...
I think they do good work...
I suppose... There may be times like that...
That's... not my thing.
I suppose...
Yeah... Aren't you the one who's tired?
You ask strange things...{wait}{clear}I've never even thought about it.
Yeah, I'll do that.
Nothing special... I just care for my sword... In case it's needed.
Yeah... If I couldn't get used to that, I couldn't travel.{wait}{clear}Or fight, for that matter...
Nothing... I just let my mind wander.
Yeah... Not home exactly... but I do remember the past sometimes.
...Fine... Do as you like.
No, nothing in particular...
Yeah, I've only just started. It's pointless if I don't keep at it...
You say strange things... It's not as if I'm fighting just for you.
Talk like that and it isn't training. By the time an enemy beats you, it's too late...
No... I'll keep going. A little longer...
